name: Cablecraft Motion Controls
old_description: In a world on the go, failure is not an option. That’s why, for over seventy years, Cablecraft has specialized in designing engineered solutions that keep things moving, reliably. But we don’t just manufacture quality motion control products and assemblies—our engineering and manufacturing experts collaborate with you to design answers to your most pressing motion control problems.
about:
Cablecraft Motion Controls is headquartered in St. Matthews, South Carolina. The company traces its origins to 1949 when Cablecraft was founded in Tacoma, Washington, to manufacture aircraft cable assemblies. Earlier roots go back to 1920 with J.J. Tourek Manufacturing Co. in Chicago producing precision screw-machine components, and 1954 with Superior Ball Joint Corp. in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The current entity emerged from a combination of Cable Manufacturing & Assembly and Cablecraft into a global leader in engineered motion controls.

The company designs and manufactures control cables (push and push-pull), rod ends, ball joints, mechanical linkages, and remote actuation products. It also produces mechatronic assemblies including electronic controls and electro-mechanical components. Cablecraft's engineering team develops proprietary components to reduce design time and tooling costs, and offers custom component design per proprietary requirements. Manufacturing capabilities include cable assembly, precision machining for ball joints and rod ends, and mechatronics integration. The firm operates a worldwide cable assembler network and provides engineering collaboration from concept to installation-ready delivery.

Cablecraft serves aerospace (sport aircraft), powersports (throttle and shift assemblies), construction (heavy-duty high-temperature applications), automotive (light vehicles), and industrial engine controls. Its customers include OEMs and tier suppliers seeking motion control solutions for critical applications. The company's application engineers work directly with client technical teams to adapt standard products or develop new designs.

Cablecraft was started to provide engineered motion control solutions that keep things moving reliably. The company emphasizes an application-focused philosophy, positioning itself as an engineering and problem-solving partner rather than just a product supplier. Its differentiation lies in combining proprietary component libraries with custom design capability to deliver installation-ready assemblies that reduce customer production complexity.
